purpose: Teach: 基幹/分譲/大差/特価/シチュエーション/通算/表題/ラインナップ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、基幹業務を強化しろ
lines.en: We need to strengthen our core business operations.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with measured weight. No room for negotiation in the tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規マンションの分譲計画を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with the new condominium development plan.
lines.style: Respectful, formal register. Steady delivery without rush. Confirms understanding with quiet precision. Hands rest on desk or at sides — composed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、他社と大差ないままでは伸びない
lines.en: We won't grow if we remain indistinguishable from our competitors.
lines.style: Firm conviction. Slight lean forward on 'indistinguishable.' Not unkind, but unambiguous. The tone of someone stating a problem to solve, not criticizing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。特価商品の販売を始めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll begin rolling out our discount product line.
lines.style: Clear acknowledgment. Tempo slightly quicker than the previous line — shows readiness. Professional but not stiff. Meeting the boss's energy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様のシチュエーションに合わせた提案をしろ
lines.en: Tailor your proposals to the client's specific situation.
lines.style: Instructive but not condescending. Brief pause before the directive. Delivered as wisdom, not criticism. The voice of someone who has seen this done wrong.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。年間通算売上の集計を完了しました
lines.en: Yes. We've completed the annual sales reconciliation.
lines.style: Factual delivery. Quiet confidence in the completion. No embellishment. Professional formality maintained but with a hint of satisfaction underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新メニューの表題を決めろ
lines.en: Decide on the naming strategy for our new product line.
lines.style: Final directive. Slightly slower tempo. Each word deliberate. Not harsh, but expectant — this matters and Kenji knows it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品のラインナップを公開いたしました
lines.en: Yes. We've made the new product lineup public.
lines.style: Concluding line. Calm, assured delivery. A touch lighter than before — something completed, handed over. Still formal but with subtle closure.
